before_model.text:
# IK5 approval corpus: a small orders model for the ILP bridge. Synthetic (IK-R10).
# The one declared rule exists so a class-mode manifest can name a rule (IK3
# requires one); IK5 binds it and otherwise ignores it.
version: 1
model_id: ik5-orders
source:
  kind: fixture
object_types:
  - id: order
    name: Order
    kind: entity
    reference: { mode: popular, value_type: order_id }
  - id: order_id
    name: OrderId
    kind: value
    primitive: Integer
  - id: customer
    name: Customer
    kind: entity
    reference: { mode: popular, value_type: customer_code }
  - id: customer_code
    name: CustomerCode
    kind: value
    primitive: String
  - id: amount
    name: Amount
    kind: value
    primitive: Integer
fact_types:
  - id: order_by
    reading: "{Order} is placed by {Customer}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: order, role_name: order }
      - { object_type: customer, role_name: customer }
    constraints:
      - id: u_order_customer
        type: uniqueness
        roles: [order]
        source: explicit
        status: confirmed
        modality: alethic
        provenance: { user_quote: "Each order is placed by one customer." }
  - id: order_amount
    reading: "{Order} has {Amount}"
    roles:
      - { object_type: order, role_name: order }
      - { object_type: amount, role_name: amount }
  - id: order_flagged
    reading: "{Order} is flagged"
    roles:
      - { object_type: order, role_name: order }
  - id: customer_blocked
    reading: "{Customer} is blocked"
    roles:
      - { object_type: customer, role_name: customer }
constraints: []
